newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Evander non-execs back contract cancel deal.
newsitem.headline: Evander non-execs back contract cancel deal.

text.p: Gencor Ltd's gold division, Gengold, said on Monday that the non-executive directors of Evander Gold Mines Ltd had recommended Evander to cancel its management contracts at the proposed merger value of 127.6 million rand.

Gengold said the report of the non-executives had concluded that it was to the advantage of Evander to cancel the agreement at the value of 127.6 million as determined by Rand Merchant Bank and UAL Merchant Bank.
The planned cancellation fee had been criticised last year by leading fund manager Julian Baring of UK-based Mercury Asset Management.

Baring, whose Mercury Gold and General Fund has 47 percent of its portfolio invested in South Africa, had applauded the cancellation of the management contract in principle but had challenged the size of the cancellation fee.

Gengold said Evander would continue to purchase certain services from it in future and these services would be offered at cost. In the current financial year these costs would constitute approximately two percent of estimated working costs.
